newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Two Romania T-bill issues fully - subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Two Romania T-bill issues fully - subscribed.

text.p: Two issues of Romania's Finance Ministry treasury bills were fully subscribed this week, central bank (BNR) data showed on Friday.

Seven banks and their corporate clients bought the 116.14 billion lei ($17.6 million) worth of 91-day papers offered on Thursday. Friday's 10 billion lei issue of 90-day T-bills went to state-owned Banc Post SA.
The bills, placed through public subscriptions, offer an annual yield calculated at the average of the BNR's weekly auctioned credits rates during their life period.
The average auctioned rate stayed almost unchanged at 226.08 percent this week against a previous 226.31 percent.
-- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264 ($ = 6600 Romanian Lei)
